title: Jacob's Dream at Bethel
description: On his way to Haran, Jacob spends the night at a certain place and dreams of a ladder reaching from earth to heaven with God's angels going up and down on it. The Lord stands above it and promises him the land, numerous descendants, and His presence. Jacob sets up the stone as a memorial pillar, names the place Bethel, and makes a vow to God.
